name: dsh-graft-slice
description: Slice a closed source-session log at its last turn/end and inject a minimal, durable handoff session without forking.
notes: Permissions are declarative metadata for this package. DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 does not enforce per-plugin permission manifests; actual capability comes from the injected services.
The runtime entry is index.js, generated from src/index.ts. activate is an alias of apply for callers that expect that name.
